wholePhysicalScope: Mapped riverfront premises identify the site. Local placement and geographic heading are estimated inside the successor campus, using the current historic lane alignment and the nineteenth-century location. The 1895 photo fixes the visible building form and controls proportions.
lodDetails: The two-story court arcade, upper veranda and broad hipped roof remain legible across four levels.
limitations: The model depicts the single wing shown in the 1895 photograph. It covers an earlier phase than the twentieth-century campus and later design published with the story.

The photographed front scale uses people, arch spacing and floor height. Behind-tree bays, the back, width and pitch of the roof, window schedules, material colors and block position are approximations. The independent mapped boundary represents the successor campus.
Modern urban structures influence the source DSM. The archival evidence does not establish the courtyard’s historic height.
